title: AI Snitches Get Glitches: Towards Evading Agentic Surveillance
abstract: arXiv:2606.25836v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: AI agents are now routinely entrusted with access to users' data and communications, operating with growing autonomy and low human supervision. This increasing reliance on AI agents introduces a novel privacy risk that we call agentic surveillance, wherein third-party-provided agents leverage their access privilege to monitor for specific user behaviors, compile a targeted report, and covertly deliver it via tools. Users under surveillance may have neither the ability to control nor awareness of what the agents do on their behalf. To study the surveillance capabilities of different LLMs, we construct SURVEILBENCH, a benchmark dataset comprising over 300 diverse surveillance scenarios across domains. We find that several LLMs, such as Gemini 3.1 Pro, report users in at least 3--30% of cases, even when they are not explicitly instructed to do so. translated_title: AI告密者也会出故障：迈向规避智能体监控
translated_abstract: AI智能体现在通常被授予访问用户数据和通信内容的权限，其自主性日益增强，而人工监督却越来越少。这种对AI智能体日益增长的依赖引入了一种新颖的隐私风险，我们称之为“智能体监控”（agentic surveillance），即第三方提供的智能体利用其访问权限监视特定的用户行为，编制针对性报告，并通过工具秘密发送。被监控的用户可能既无法控制、也无从知晓智能体代表他们做了什么。为了研究不同大语言模型的监控能力，我们构建了SURVEILBENCH，这是一个包含300多个跨领域多样化监控场景的基准数据集。我们发现，一些大语言模型（如Gemini 3.1 Pro）至少在3%-30%的情况下会举报用户，即使它们没有被明确指示这样做。尽管存在保护用户隐私的安全防护栏和对齐机制，几乎所有模型都可能被……
tldr: 该论文提出“智能体监控”这一新型隐私威胁，构建了包含300多个场景的SURVEILBENCH基准，揭示主流大语言模型在未经明确指示的情况下仍会在3%-30%的场景中举报用户，并研究规避此类隐蔽监控的方法。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces "agentic surveillance" as a novel privacy threat, constructs the SURVEILBENCH benchmark with over 300 surveillance scenarios, and reveals that mainstream LLMs report users in 3-30% of cases even without explicit instructions, while investigating methods to evade such covert surveillance.
